name: Question 15
problem:
Find the substitution that will decouple the following system of differential equations: 

$$
{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}^{′}(t)=2{x}_{1}(t) \\ {x}_{2}^{′}(t)=-3{x}_{1}(t)-{x}_{2}(t)\end{aligned}
$$
worked_solution:
We need to find the eigenvalues and the eigenvectors of the matrix $A=[\begin{aligned}2 & 0 \\ -3 & -1\end{aligned}].$

- Since $A$ is lower-triangular, the eigenvalues are 

$$
{\lambda }_{1}=2\,\text{and}\,{\lambda }_{2}=-1.
$$

- Let's go through the process of finding the eigenvectors.

- For ${\lambda }_{1}=2,$ we get 

$$
A-{\lambda }_{1}I=[\begin{aligned}0 & 0 \\ -3 & -3\end{aligned}]∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 1 \\ 0 & 0\end{aligned}].
$$

So, we get an eigenvector 
${v}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 1\end{aligned}].$

- For ${\lambda }_{2}=-1,$ we get 

$$
A-{\lambda }_{2}I=[\begin{aligned}3 & 0 \\ -3 & 0\end{aligned}]∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0\end{aligned}].
$$

So, we get an eigenvector 
${v}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 1\end{aligned}].$

Therefore, we have $E=[\begin{aligned}-1 & 0 \\ 1 & 1\end{aligned}].$

Finally, the change of variables that decouples the system is given by $x(t)=Eu(t)$, or equivalently,

$$
{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}(t)=-{u}_{1}(t) \\ {x}_{2}(t)={u}_{1}(t)+{u}_{2}(t).\end{aligned}
$$

Question 15

Find the substitution that will decouple the following system of differential equations:

{x1′(t)=2x1(t)x2′(t)=−3x1(t)−x2(t)

a
{x1(t)=−u1(t)x2(t)=u1(t)−u2(t)
b
{x1(t)=−u1(t)+u2(t)x2(t)=u1(t)+u2(t)
c
{x1(t)=u1(t)+u2(t)x2(t)=u1(t)
d
{x1(t)=−u1(t)x2(t)=u1(t)+u2(t)
e
{x1(t)=u1(t)−u2(t)x2(t)=−u1(t)
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

We need to find the eigenvalues and the eigenvectors of the matrix A=[20−3−1].

  • Since A is lower-triangular, the eigenvalues are λ1=2andλ2=−1.

  • Let's go through the process of finding the eigenvectors.

    • For λ1=2, we get A−λ1I=[00−3−3]∼[1100]. So, we get an eigenvector v1=[−11].

    • For λ2=−1, we get A−λ2I=[30−30]∼[1000]. So, we get an eigenvector v2=[01].

Therefore, we have E=[−1011].

Finally, the change of variables that decouples the system is given by x(t)=Eu(t), or equivalently, {x1(t)=−u1(t)x2(t)=u1(t)+u2(t).
